properties.title: Kaguya GRS Nuclide Map - Potassium
properties.lri:data_use_note: Elemental potassium abundance (ppm) from the Kaguya GRS Nuclide Map at 1° resolution (~30 km). K is a KREEP indicator - high K, together with high Th, marks Procellarum KREEP Terrane material of interest for resource prospecting.
properties.measurement_depth: few tens of centimeters (bulk subsurface, not surface)
properties.processing:lineage: Raw UInt16 binary (GRS_NMAP_K_071214_081216.img, detached PDS3 label) read via GDAL's PDS driver and converted to K ppm using gdal_calc.py with the label formula raw x 0.1 - 0. Reassigned from the PDS driver's projected CRS (metres) to IAU:30100 (degrees, same sphere and grid) and written as COG via gdal_translate with DEFLATE/PREDICTOR=3 compression.

processing_script.title: Exact processing commands used to generate the COG

source_label.title: Detached PDS3 label describing the source binary
